links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus gold-standard Dutch patient information resources
links.effect: Best-performing LLMs were less readable than the gold-standard PIR; Gemini performed best in readability among LLMs (P < 0.001), but the GS-PIR remained more readable.
links.quote: The best-performing LLMs outperformed the GS-PIR on completeness and personalization, yet it was less accurate and less readable.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM responses to the same questions over 8 months
links.effect: Response reproducibility decreased for all LLMs over time, showing variability across outcomes.
links.quote: Over time, response reproducibility decreased for all LLMs, showing variability across outcomes.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Gemini) compared to established patient information resources on answering 50 melanoma-related questions, assessing accuracy, completeness, readability, and reproducibility over time.
